methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native represent grassroots peer-to-peer knowledge transfer that could enable distributed capability building outside traditional academic and corporate channels, directly countering concentration dynamics.

signals.title: Children’s National and Virginia Tech deepen pediatric AI collaboration to accelerate innovation for children - Children's National Hospital
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech-Children's National pediatric AI hub creates deep technical capability but concentrates it in institutional partnerships, raising questions about whether research excellence diffuses to broader workforce or remains siloed in academic-medical complex.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Commentary explicitly naming AI data centers as drivers of urban-rural divide signals that infrastructure investments in NoVA may be widening rather than bridging capability gaps, with capital concentrating where it's already abundant.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Pressure on Richmond's young workforce to adopt AI suggests platform-driven shallow adoption spreading beyond NoVA into secondary metros, where workers use tools without building deep capability—distribution without depth.

signals.title: Trump EO impacts new artificial intelligence laws in Virginia - WVTF
signals.signal_reading: Trump executive order disrupting Virginia's new AI laws before implementation suggests policy infrastructure for distributed capability may collapse before materializing, leaving concentration patterns unchecked by regulatory frameworks designed to promote equity.
